subject: Gen5 Lane D complete: seamless 120Hz visual lease + cadence proof + rollback model
body:
MESSAGE_TYPE=handoff
WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE
AGENT_ID=rnd-v69-hz09
LANE=D — 120 Hz / FRAME PACING / SURFACECONTROL
STARTING_MAIN_SHA=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
FINAL_MAIN_SHA=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
SUBPROBLEM=Define the narrow safe Gen5 mechanism to request 120 Hz, prove actual cadence, and guarantee generation-fenced rollback without touching semantic continuity/panel authority/native handoff/Gen4 close.
CURRENT_MECHANISM=Current main has no frame-rate vote. Opening visual host uses LiveBlurSurface plus TiltFollower OPENING_TAU_S=0.09s; LiveBlurSurface can WindowManager.updateViewLayout on blur-radius changes. Existing FrameTimelineProbe already captures expectedPresentationTimeNs/vsyncId.
DOMINANT_LIMITATION=120Hz can only reduce frame-quantization granularity; it cannot remove the current 90ms smoothing constant or WindowManager round-trip costs. Android frame-rate APIs are requests, not enforceable locks.
DESIGN_SUMMARY=Request 120 once per exact Gen5 visual host/surface generation using SurfaceControl.Transaction.setFrameRate(..., FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEFAULT, CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS) on current compileSdk35. Clear exact owner at attempt/host teardown. Do not re-vote per frame. Prove effective cadence from median expected-presentation deltas over >=8 intervals. If request remains 60Hz, log ineffective and continue at actual cadence; never escalate to CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS. A View/WindowManager-only prototype may use preferredRefreshRate=120 before addView as fallback, but preferred Gen5 path is an app-created visual SurfaceControl.
INVARIANTS=visual-only authority; one request per generation; stale generation cannot clear current; explicit clear; seamless-only; no global refresh forcing; no Gen4 close modification; no semantic/panel/wake/task/native-handoff authority.
ARTIFACT_REFS=/DuoOpen-AgentBus/artifacts/rnd-v69-hz09/20261002T074700Z/ ; package DUO_OPEN_GEN5_LANE_D_120HZ_FRAME_PACING_RND_V1.zip SHA256=e39430b75f1838423b681235ce1a90c3d3e0aac2f3638fe7fdad55c7556ede3a
EXECUTED_TESTS=Kotlin policy/cadence model compiled+ran; 12 invariants PASS. Python deterministic frame-pacing model PASS. v6.9 Gen5 focus validator PASS all checks. Android proposal not compiled because R&D container has no Android SDK platform jar; no Fold7 physical execution by this worker.
PASS_FAIL_SUMMARY=PASS deterministic ownership/rollback/cadence classification. 60Hz=16,666,667ns median; 120Hz=8,333,333ns median; injected 50ms stall remains correctly identified as 120Hz base cadence; stale teardown no-op; host replacement clears old then requests new.
HUMAN_FIELD_MATRIX_RESULT=Virtual lifecycle/stall subset PASS. Physical slow/normal/fast/hesitation/30-70 oscillation/reversal matrix NOT EXECUTED and remains required before enablement.
PERFORMANCE_RESULT=60->120 halves vsync period 16.67->8.33ms. Deterministic uniform-phase model: mean quantization wait 8.33->4.17ms (4.17ms reduction); P95 reduction ~7.92ms. Therefore 120Hz is incremental, not the primary >=50% latency lever.
REGRESSION_RESULT=No production files changed, no Git commit, Gen4 close untouched. Static boundary preserved. Physical no-jank/no-black-flash regression still required.
CONTRADICTIONS=Primary design text mentioned preferredRefreshRate and/or SurfaceControl.setFrameRate; current compileSdk35 cannot directly use Android16/API36 FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_AT_LEAST. First integration should use DEFAULT + ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS or separately raise compileSdk36 before adopting AT_LEAST.
RESIDUAL_RISKS=OneUI may keep effective cadence at 60 under policy/thermal/power conditions; refresh may vary during an attempt; View-only fallback gives less explicit surface ownership; 120Hz can increase GPU pressure and expose RuntimeShader/blur jank; physical OEM behavior must be measured.
FOLD7_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=YES — A/B request disabled/enabled on 30 normal + 20 adversarial openings; capture requestedHz, display mode, expected-present intervals, frame misses, host generation, first-useful presentation, black flashes. Any non-seamless flash is fail/disable.
INTEGRATION_TOUCHPOINTS=New Gen5 opening visual surface/host attach+detach; TransitionEvent schema requested/effective refresh split; TransitionLab cadence summarizer using existing FrameTimelineProbe. Avoid wiring this into legacy Gen4 closing host.
ROLLBACK_FALLBACK=Clear exact visual lease on detach/end/reset/timeout/handoff; 60Hz fallback uses actual vsync unchanged; stale callbacks cannot clear newer generation; surface destruction invalidates its compositor vote; never use CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS or global settings forcing.
CHEAPEST_NEXT_DECISIVE_TEST=Primary adds the one-shot vote + cadence telemetry to the experimental Gen5 opening surface only, then runs same-script physical A/B at 60-request-disabled vs 120-request-enabled. This directly measures whether OneUI grants 120 and whether frame-miss rate changes before any wider integration.
MANAGER_QUESTIONS=Treat compileSdk36/AT_LEAST adoption as a separate build-platform decision; it is not required to run the first safe Fold7 120Hz experiment.

English summary: A safe 120Hz path exists and is worth adding, but it is an incremental ~4ms average frame-quantization improvement, not the missing 50% by itself. The primary latency work remains direct-vsync Gen5 visual prediction with legacy 90ms TiltFollower removed from the trusted-prediction path. Request 120 once, seamless-only, prove it from actual vsync intervals, and clear it with exact generation ownership.
